_comment: Per-game extras hand-entered for games whose league export was incomplete — keyed by game id (<date>-<opponent-slug>). 'half_scores' feeds the By-half box when there's no play-by-play to derive it from; 'scoring' is the made-shot breakdown (two=2pt makes, three=3pt makes, ft=free-throw makes) shown on the game page as makes-only. 'penalty_points' ({us, them, note}) are team points on the scoreboard that belong to no player — e.g. league fouls/penalties applied before tip-off — added on top of the on-court box to make the final score, counted in the result and points for/against but kept out of shooting, ratings and every player stat. 'stage' ({label, short} or a plain string) marks a finals/playoff game: it is labelled by its stage (e.g. 'Semi-Final' / 'SF') instead of a weekly round number, since it isn't part of the regular-season ladder. None of these touch season shooting totals. The build checks they all reconcile to the box points.
